name: Agent Board
description: Lists the Server's Agent sessions with their status, Tab, provider, freshness and place, waiting ones first, and jumps to the chosen session's terminal after checking the session again.

states: Inspect the waiting session first, a stale and a disconnected one, one no Panel can reach, and the dimmed ended ones, each named by its Tab and placed by its Workspace.
Move the selection with Up, Down, j, k, Home and End, and see the selected row follow the keyboard and scroll into view.
Inspect the same rows, status words and footer in Simplified Chinese.
See the status line say the listing is incomplete while the rows stay.
See the warning that says why the last jump stopped.
See the empty list say that the Server has no Agent sessions, with Open disabled.
See the list say why the first read failed.

useWhen: A person looks across Workspaces for an Agent session the Server runs and goes to its terminal.
avoidWhen: The person finds a Tab, Workspace, or action by name; use the Unified Search Surface.
The person follows the Agents of one Workspace; the sidebar's Agent overview shows them in place.
invariants: The board reads only while open, never within two seconds of the last read's end, and a failed or cut-short read keeps the rows of the last whole one.
Sessions that need attention come first, otherwise in the Server's order; the selection follows its session across reads, and a session id never shows.
A row reads status, then the title of its terminal's Tab, the provider, its freshness when not fresh, and its Workspace and Tab, or that no Panel can reach it; an ended session is dimmed.

Enter, Open, or a double-click reads the session again before showing its terminal, one in the shown Tab before others and a visible one before a hidden one; landing closes the board and gives that terminal the keyboard.
A jump that cannot land leaves the board open with one warning that says why, until the next jump or read; a later jump or a close supersedes a jump under way.
Escape, the close button, and backdrop dismissal return focus to where it was when the board opened.
Up, Down, j, k, Home, and End move the selection and r reads again; a key held with Ctrl, Alt, or Meta passes through.
